global_rules: Before any write or Blender execution, re-read remote HEAD and preserve newer work.
Do not enter Phase 5 or a later phase while the whole-body issue ledger reports a Critical/High blocker.
A numerical pass never closes a visual anatomy issue; Fixed or Accepted requires committed closure evidence.
Never work from main and never merge the model branch wholesale into the standalone runtime branch.
Historical epoch baselines, the locked rev2c rig, acceptance thresholds and frozen stress-pose definitions remain protected.
No legacy V-series implementation data or third-party character content may enter ORIGINAL v1.
Routine owner review snapshots are non-blocking; final owner acceptance/freeze authorization remain explicit later gates.
Every candidate/output uses a fresh revision/label/path; never overwrite historical evidence.
Prepared tooling is not phase completion. Actual execution evidence controls progression.
A live anatomical-recovery override takes precedence over historically generated phase-complete fields until its evidence-bound release condition is satisfied.
